# Completeness

A completeness score derived from a weighted checklist of estate data categories, scoped to a specific jurisdiction and estate status

Source: [`v3/common/completeness.json`](../../../v3/common/completeness.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/completeness.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `score` | `integer` | yes | Overall completeness percentage, calculated from the weighted checklist items |
| `maxScore` | `integer` | yes | Maximum possible score for this jurisdiction and estate status combination. May be less than 100 if certain categories are not applicable |
| `jurisdiction` | `string` | | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or ISO 3166-2 subdivision code identifying which jurisdiction this scoring applies to |
| `estateStatus` | `string` | | The estate status this completeness score was calculated against. Different statuses may require different data, affecting which checklist items are applicable |
| `calculatedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | ISO 8601 date-time when this completeness score was computed |
| `checklist` | array of `object` | yes | The individual items assessed to produce the overall score. Each item belongs to a category, has a relative weight, and a status indicating whether the data is present |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
